hypothesis: Restricting the current Patrick K10 fill to the direction in which the completed weekly value area midpoint has moved improves net outcomes across periods and costs.
baseline: Existing small_pullback (fill_filter=7), Tokyo decision/fill at 08:00/08:15 JST, VA membership and modeled cost <=10% of reverse stop width; actual entry side is reverse swap. Require the 15 complete M1 before fill, favorable move >= modeled cost and adverse excursion <= half the favorable move. Verify all 32 control ledgers against patrick_cost10_va_preentry_shape.
data_manifest: agent_runs/patrick_h4_7d_reverse_20261107/result.json: verify Bars.dat and info.dat SHA256 per symbol. Minute OHLC treated as Bid; source volume is a proxy.
entry_timeframe: M1 replay; decision at 08:00 JST and fill at 08:15 on JST weekdays.
higher_timeframe_rules: Current completed H4 setup and original weekly VA/level selection. Two preceding calendar weeks of the decision's UTC Monday week for the candidate. Same UTC week at fill; Monday morning JST still belongs to the previous UTC week.
entry_rules: Gate only the pending fill selected by the original rule. Reject if either week's VAH/VAL is nonfinite or VAH<=VAL. Let m1,m2 be (VAH+VAL)/2 for previous, two-weeks-prior UTC weeks. Require actual fill side * (m1-m2)>0, strictly in native price units. No alternative setup on rejection. Replay subsequent holds and eligible entries for each arm separately.

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: Original variable reverse-swap TP/SL and 3-calendar-day deadline; same M1 double-touch uses stop priority.

periods.additional_diagnostic: 2026-01-05 inclusive to 2026-08-28 exclusive UTC; prior state carried forward across the year boundary; data load through 2026-08-31 exclusive.

final_period_prior_exposure: All reported periods already examined in other Patrick experiments. No pristine holdout; 2026 is descriptive and ends before the known GBPJPY scale break. If historically rejected, stop. If all gates pass, assess an additional earlier regime before any further conclusion.
search_space: One signed midpoint migration rule. No threshold optimization, pair selection, alternative filter, or retuning.
cost_and_fill_model: Fix baseline model: normal/stress spread 1/2 pips, slip 0.1/0.2 pip per side, carry 0.2/1 pip per elapsed day. Selection models three carry days. No commission beyond modeled costs. Open gaps and intrabar stop/target handling inherited; no M1 gap filling.
position_sizing_and_currency: Separate 100 starting units per symbol, baseline risk convention (1% capital per R). Pooled measures weight each closed trade by net R, not merged account P/L.
acceptance_gates: Screen 6 historical period x cost cells independently. To advance, in EVERY cell require >=30 candidate closes, >=6 traded pairs, candidate PF_R>1 and strictly higher than control, and candidate mean net R>0 and strictly higher than control. Report win rate and summed R as diagnostics (frequency/return trade-off), plus realized drawdown by symbol. Report 2026 separately regardless; historical failure ends this experiment.
cross_symbol_rule: Fixed 16 FX pairs; no pair exclusions from results; report counts of active pairs by cell.
